lines.zh: 我的脚步踩着四拍，一步不错。
lines.en: I walk in four-four time, never missing a beat.

lines.zh: 走廊很暗，我偏要踏出声音。
lines.en: The corridor is dark; I make my steps loud anyway.

lines.zh: 象牙在口袋里互相碰，像响板。
lines.en: My ivory pieces click in my pocket like castanets.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，影子先到一步。
lines.en: I hug the wall; my shadow arrives a step early.

lines.zh: 爵士乐从门缝漏出来，我跟着。
lines.en: Jazz leaks through the door crack, and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，靴子却是硬底。
lines.en: I step lightly, though my soles are hard.

lines.zh: 这条巷子我走过七十次。
lines.en: I have walked this alley seventy times.

lines.zh: 我绕开碎玻璃，怕惊动你。
lines.en: I avoid the broken glass so you stay calm.

lines.zh: 舞台空了，我还在台下转。
lines.en: The stage is empty; I still circle below it.

lines.zh: 我走在拍子后面，慢半口气。
lines.en: I walk behind the beat, half a breath late.

lines.zh: 地板吱呀，我数着每一块。
lines.en: The floorboards creak; I count every one.

lines.zh: 我从吧台后出来，手里没有杯。
lines.en: I come from behind the bar with no glass.

lines.zh: 我靠在音箱上，听里面的雨。
lines.en: I lean on the speaker and hear rain inside.

lines.zh: 萨克斯停了，耳朵还在响。
lines.en: The sax has stopped; my ears still ring.

lines.zh: 我用象牙敲桌，敲出一个小调。
lines.en: I tap ivory on the table, a minor key.

lines.zh: 烟在灯下打转，我看了很久。
lines.en: Smoke turns under the lamp; I watch a while.

lines.zh: 我数着天花板上的铜钉。
lines.en: I count the brass studs on the ceiling.

lines.zh: 这地方太安静，像等开场。
lines.en: This place is too quiet, like before a set.

lines.zh: 我把领口整理好，虽然没人看。
lines.en: I fix my collar, though nobody is watching.

lines.zh: 我的牙很白，我一直知道。
lines.en: My teeth are very white; I have always known.

lines.zh: 我在等下一首，等得有点久。
lines.en: I wait for the next song, a little too long.

lines.zh: 杯子空了，我还是举了一下。
lines.en: The glass is empty; I raise it anyway.

lines.zh: 你站在灯外，我看得见你。
lines.en: You stand outside the light; I see you.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟打着拍子，很生疏。
lines.en: Your heel taps the beat, clumsily.

lines.zh: 我只看你的手腕，那里脉跳得快。
lines.en: I watch your wrist, where the pulse runs quick.

lines.zh: 你身上有铜管的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of brass.

lines.zh: 别装作来听曲子的。
lines.en: Do not pretend you came for the music.

lines.zh: 我看你的脖子，尺寸正合适。
lines.en: I look at your neck; the size suits me.

lines.zh: 你退半步，我就知道怕了。
lines.en: You step back half a pace; I know fear.

lines.zh: 灯照着你，也照着我。
lines.en: The lamp lights you, and it lights me.

lines.zh: 你笑得不错，可惜太早。
lines.en: Your smile is good, but far too early.

lines.zh: 我数过你身上的口袋，三个。
lines.en: I counted your pockets; there are three.

lines.zh: 你打中我的下巴，牙磕了一下。
lines.en: You hit my jaw; my teeth knock together.

lines.zh: 这一下让我漏了一拍。
lines.en: That blow cost me one beat.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸口袋，象牙还在。
lines.en: I check my pocket; the ivory is there.

lines.zh: 你下手不轻，我很欣赏。
lines.en: You hit hard; I appreciate that.

lines.zh: 我的外套破了，补起来要钱。
lines.en: My coat is torn; mending costs money.

lines.zh: 疼让我清醒，谢谢。
lines.en: Pain sharpens me; thank you.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，拍子重新数过。
lines.en: I step back and count the rhythm anew.

lines.zh: 你砍在我肩上，刀卡住了。
lines.en: You cut my shoulder; the blade sticks.

lines.zh: 血从嘴角下来，我舔掉了。
lines.en: Blood runs from my lip; I lick it away.

lines.zh: 这一下，我会写进歌里。
lines.en: I will put this blow into a song.

lines.zh: 钱？我更想听一段独奏。
lines.en: Money? I would rather hear a solo.

lines.zh: 你晃那块肉，我不吃熟的。
lines.en: You wave that meat; I do not eat it cooked.

lines.zh: 把象牙递过来，我看看成色。
lines.en: Hand me the ivory; let me check its grain.

lines.zh: 酒留着，我的喉咙不归我管。
lines.en: Keep the wine; my throat is not mine to command.

lines.zh: 你用金子敲桌，声音太闷。
lines.en: You tap gold on the table; it sounds dull.

lines.zh: 我不收礼物，只收欠条。
lines.en: I take no gifts, only debts.

lines.zh: 那块怀表走得慢，像我。
lines.en: That pocket watch runs slow, like me.

lines.zh: 你别吹口哨，那曲子我吹过。
lines.en: Do not whistle; I have played that tune.

lines.zh: 甜味引不动我，铜管声才行。
lines.en: Sweetness cannot move me; only brass can.

lines.zh: 拿开吧，我只对你的手腕好奇。
lines.en: Put it away; I am curious about your wrist.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，骨头先响了一声。
lines.en: You bump me; my bones sound first.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶你，指甲有点长。
lines.en: I steady you; my nails are a little long.

lines.zh: 让让，我的象牙怕碰。
lines.en: Make way; my ivory bruises easily.

lines.zh: 我们肩碰肩，算是打过招呼。
lines.en: Shoulder to shoulder, we have greeted each other.

lines.zh: 你踩了我的鞋，我不计较。
lines.en: You stepped on my shoe; I let it pass.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得正好在拍子上。
lines.en: That bump landed right on the beat.

lines.zh: 我侧身让你，你却没过去。
lines.en: I turn to let you by; you do not pass.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我牙口不好。
lines.en: Do not press so close; my bite is poor.

lines.zh: 我退开，衣角扫过你的膝盖。
lines.en: I draw back; my coat brushes your knee.

lines.zh: 撞完没倒，你的骨头还算硬。
lines.en: Still upright after that; your bones hold.

lines.zh: 我的搭档走了，位置还空着。
lines.en: My partner left; the spot stays empty.

lines.zh: 我只和会数拍子的人合奏。
lines.en: I only play with those who can count time.

lines.zh: 象牙我留了一对，没有送出去。
lines.en: I kept a pair of tusks and gave none away.

lines.zh: 台下没有人为我留座。
lines.en: No one keeps a seat for me below the stage.

lines.zh: 情话我只会用切分音说。
lines.en: I can only say sweet things in syncopation.

lines.zh: 她嫌我的牙太长，就走了。
lines.en: She said my teeth were too long, and left.

lines.zh: 这首慢板，我一直没弹完。
lines.en: I never finished that slow piece.

lines.zh: 两个人合拍，比独奏难。
lines.en: Two in time is harder than playing alone.

lines.zh: 我的影子只有一个，够了。
lines.en: I have only one shadow, and that is enough.

lines.zh: 别问我这些，调子会乱。
lines.en: Do not ask me that; the tune will break.

lines.zh: 我捡起你掉的票根，还留着。
lines.en: I pick up your ticket stub and keep it.

lines.zh: 铜币滚到脚边，我用鞋底压住。
lines.en: A copper coin rolled over; I pin it with my sole.

lines.zh: 我弯腰时，腰上的象牙响了。
lines.en: Bending down, the ivory at my waist clinks.

lines.zh: 这根断弦我收着，弹不出声。
lines.en: I keep this broken string; it makes no sound.

lines.zh: 你把刀落下，我替你捡。
lines.en: You drop your knife; I pick it up for you.

lines.zh: 我抬起那只箱子，里面是空的。
lines.en: I lift that chest; there is nothing inside.

lines.zh: 别让我捡你的手指，太麻烦。
lines.en: Do not make me pick up your fingers; tedious.

lines.zh: 我拾起一片锡纸，照见自己。
lines.en: I pick up tinfoil and see myself in it.

lines.zh: 这枚扣子很亮，我留着。
lines.en: This button is bright; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，怕你误会。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly so you misunderstand nothing.

lines.zh: 你推门进来，风把谱子吹乱了。
lines.en: You pushed the door open and scattered my sheets.

lines.zh: 我的拍子停了，全因为你。
lines.en: My beat stopped, and it is entirely your doing.

lines.zh: 这间屋子今晚只留一个人。
lines.en: Only one of us leaves this room tonight.

lines.zh: 你身上有生人的调子。
lines.en: You carry the tune of a stranger.

lines.zh: 我看见你摸刀了，别装。
lines.en: I saw you touch your knife; do not pretend.

lines.zh: 门在身后关上了，听见没有？
lines.en: The door shut behind you; did you hear it?

lines.zh: 我等了整晚，就等这一下。
lines.en: I waited all night for exactly this.

lines.zh: 灯光缩成一圈，你在里面。
lines.en: The light shrinks to a ring, and you are in it.

lines.zh: 我的牙在发痒，不太礼貌。
lines.en: My teeth itch, which is impolite.

lines.zh: 你踩错了拍子，我听见了。
lines.en: You missed the beat; I heard it.

lines.zh: 别往后退，后面是音箱。
lines.en: Do not back up; the speaker is behind you.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，示意乐队停下。
lines.en: I raise my hand; the band falls silent.

lines.zh: 你来得正好，曲子刚起。
lines.en: You came at the right time; the song just began.

lines.zh: 这一场，我不打算谢幕。
lines.en: I do not plan to take a bow tonight.

lines.zh: 你的靴子在木地板上，太响了。
lines.en: Your boots on the boards are far too loud.

lines.zh: 灯下的影子只有我一个，现在多一个。
lines.en: There was one shadow under the lamp, now there are two.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚步走，不抢拍。
lines.en: I follow your steps and never rush the beat.

lines.zh: 你往吧台后面躲，我绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind the bar; I walk around it.

lines.zh: 我的象牙在指间转，慢慢转。
lines.en: My ivory turns between my fingers, slowly.

lines.zh: 你听，我的靴声越来越近。
lines.en: Listen; my boots are getting closer.

lines.zh: 这间屋子的出口，只有一个。
lines.en: This room has exactly one way out.

lines.zh: 你喘得太响，节拍都乱了。
lines.en: You breathe too loudly; the rhythm breaks.

lines.zh: 我不急，好曲子要慢慢听。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; good songs unfold slowly.

lines.zh: 你绕了三圈，还是回到我这里。
lines.en: You circled three times and came back to me.

lines.zh: 我把椅子踢开，路就通了。
lines.en: I kick a chair aside and the path opens.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯在抖，真好看。
lines.en: The lamp in your hand shakes; it is lovely.

lines.zh: 我数三下，你就该转身了。
lines.en: I count three, and you should turn around.

lines.zh: 别碰门把手，我在看着。
lines.en: Do not touch the handle; I am watching.

lines.zh: 我们的距离只剩一段独奏。
lines.en: A single solo is all the distance left.

lines.zh: 你跑调的呼吸，我记住了。
lines.en: I have memorized your off-key breathing.

lines.zh: 我把斗篷挂上椅背，坐等。
lines.en: I hang my cloak on the chair and sit to wait.

lines.zh: 你的心跳快了一拍，我听见了。
lines.en: Your heart skipped a beat, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 我不走直线，我走鼓点。
lines.en: I do not walk straight lines, I walk downbeats.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，墙面就凉了。
lines.en: You back to the wall, and the wall goes cold.

lines.zh: 这一夜只剩我们两个和一把琴。
lines.en: Tonight it is only us two and a lute.

lines.zh: 我抬手，屋里的声音都停了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and every sound in the room stops.

lines.zh: 我这一下，直取你的喉咙。
lines.en: This strike goes straight for your throat.

lines.zh: 象牙划过你的肩，声音很轻。
lines.en: The ivory crosses your shoulder, very softly.

lines.zh: 你挡得住第一下，挡不住第二下。
lines.en: You block the first, not the second.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落在你肋骨上，很准。
lines.en: My fist lands on your ribs, precisely.

lines.zh: 血溅到琴键上，音全错了。
lines.en: Blood hits the keys; every note goes wrong.

lines.zh: 我笑着出手，牙全露出来。
lines.en: I strike smiling, all my teeth showing.

lines.zh: 你退得太急，脚跟撞到台阶。
lines.en: You back off too fast and hit the step.

lines.zh: 这一击是替那支断掉的曲子。
lines.en: This blow is for the song that broke.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的领子，往灯下拖。
lines.en: I grab your collar and drag you to the lamp.

lines.zh: 你手里的刀，握反了。
lines.en: You are holding your knife backwards.

lines.zh: 我打你一下，停一拍，再打。
lines.en: I hit you once, rest a beat, then again.

lines.zh: 骨头的响声，比鼓点还脆。
lines.en: Bone cracks sharper than a snare drum.

lines.zh: 你倒下去时，我还在数拍。
lines.en: While you fall, I am still counting time.

lines.zh: 别急着死，尾奏还没完。
lines.en: Do not die yet; the coda is unfinished.

lines.zh: 我按你的肩，把你按回节拍里。
lines.en: I press your shoulder back into the rhythm.

lines.zh: 象牙在灯下白了一下，然后是你。
lines.en: The tusk flashes white, then it is you.

lines.zh: 这一记，替那面破了的鼓。
lines.en: This one is for the drum you broke.

lines.zh: 我不收手，尾音拖得很长。
lines.en: I do not pull back; the last note is dragged out.

lines.zh: 你抓我袖子，布先碎了。
lines.en: You grab my sleeve, and the cloth tears first.

lines.zh: 我打完还整了整领结。
lines.en: When I finish, I straighten my collar.

lines.zh: 我从幕布后走出来，灯刚亮。
lines.en: I step from behind the curtain as the lights rise.

lines.zh: 爵士维度今晚开门了。
lines.en: The Jazz dimension opens its doors tonight.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖外套，落下些金粉。
lines.en: I shake my coat and gold dust falls.

lines.zh: 舞台的木地板还热着。
lines.en: The stage floorboards are still warm.

lines.zh: 我清了下嗓子，先定个调。
lines.en: I clear my throat and set the key.

lines.zh: 台下空着，我就自己坐下。
lines.en: The seats are empty, so I sit down myself.

lines.zh: 我的象牙是新的，还没磨。
lines.en: My ivory is new and not yet worn.

lines.zh: 有人把灯打开了，是谁？
lines.en: Someone turned on the lamp; who was it?

lines.zh: 我踩上台阶，木板响了三声。
lines.en: I climb the steps; the boards sound three times.

lines.zh: 这地方的烟味，我很熟。
lines.en: I know this smell of smoke very well.

lines.zh: 我推开门，乐队已经就位。
lines.en: I push the door open; the band is ready.

lines.zh: 今晚第一个客人，是你。
lines.en: Tonight's first guest is you.

lines.zh: 烧我的外套可以，象牙别碰。
lines.en: Burn my coat if you like, but not the ivory.

lines.zh: 摔下去时，我护住了口袋。
lines.en: Falling, I guarded my pocket.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，拍子全散了。
lines.en: Water fills my throat and the beat scatters.

lines.zh: 炸响像一记大鼓，我聋了半边。
lines.en: The blast is a bass drum; half my hearing is gone.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，像根细鼓槌。
lines.en: The arrow in my shoulder looks like a thin drumstick.

lines.zh: 光钻进骨头，调子变得很尖。
lines.en: Light enters my bones and the tune turns shrill.

lines.zh: 我饿，但更想听你喘气。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I would rather hear you pant.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我牙全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my teeth light up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，真难听。
lines.en: The void has no echo; it sounds awful.
